name: James Hutton Ltd
description: Raspberry genetics owner/licensor. Global Plant Genetics (GPG) extended its exclusive representation contract for James Hutton Ltd's raspberry genetics to Moroccan and Tunisian producers (Hortidaily). Commercial IP arm associated with the James Hutton Institute's public raspberry/blackberry breeding research in Scotland -- recorded here strictly as named in the available Evidence, not merged with the Institute itself absent direct evidence they are the same legal entity.
